mapper.select: SELECT id,notify_channel channel,notify_recipients recipients_json,notify_content content,retry_count,max_retries,target_user_id,alert_instance_id FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND retry_count<max_retries AND ((notify_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at<=NOW(3))) OR (notify_status='SENT' AND updated_at<DATE_SUB(NOW(3),INTERVAL 60 SECOND))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT id,notify_channel channel,notify_recipients recipients_json,notify_content content,retry_count,max_retries,target_user_id,alert_instance_id FROM t_alert_notification WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND notify_status='SENT'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_notification SET notify_status='DELIVERED',sent_at=NOW(3),next_attempt_at=NULL,provider_message_id=#{row.providerMessageId},last_http_status=#{row.httpStatus},last_provider_code=#{row.providerCode},last_error_type=NULL,last_error_summary=NULL WHERE id=#{row.id} AND notify_status='SENT'

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET notify_status='DEAD_LETTER',retry_count=#{row.attempt},next_attempt_at=NULL,dead_lettered_at=NOW(3),dead_letter_status='OPEN',last_http_status=#{row.httpStatus},last_provider_code=#{row.providerCode},last_error_type=#{row.errorType},last_error_summary=#{row.errorSummary} WHERE id=#{row.id} AND notify_status='SENT'

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET notify_status='FAILED',retry_count=#{row.attempt},next_attempt_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{row.delaySeconds} SECOND),last_http_status=#{row.httpStatus},last_provider_code=#{row.providerCode},last_error_type=#{row.errorType},last_error_summary=#{row.errorSummary} WHERE id=#{row.id} AND notify_status='SENT'
